mutation_format: RFC 6902 JSON Patch subset: add, remove, replace

canonical_json.algorithm: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme after semantic array sorting
canonical_json.string_order: UTF-16 code unit lexicographic order; locale/ICU collation is forbidden
canonical_json.fact_order: role, provider, model_id, thinking tag, thinking value ascending by string_order; number tag before string tag
canonical_json.content_hash: SHA-256 lowercase hex of complete canonical body bytes

histogram_bucket_semantics: (-infinity,b0], (b0,b1], ..., (bn,+infinity); bucket count is bounds length plus one

response_cases.name: accepted-ack
response_cases.client_action: persist eligibility and acknowledge immutable manifest

response_cases.name: duplicate-ack
response_cases.client_action: persist eligibility and acknowledge immutable manifest

response_cases.name: request-conflict
response_cases.client_action: dead-letter without changing request id or bytes

response_cases.name: quota-limited
response_cases.client_action: persist wait and replay exact manifest

server_retention_constraints.country_source: trusted edge request.cf.country; invalid or missing becomes ZZ
server_retention_constraints.sessions_started: sum once per (device_id,bucket_id) for global/platform only

expected.invariant: generation coverage requires reported token usage
every real provider attempt duration is at least 1 ms
